headline: Missile Command's second seat gets the arcade's three buttons — and main came back green by lunch
lede: A dead session's half-proven build was picked up, finished and shipped: hot-seat player two now names its own batteries, exactly like the 1980 cabinet. The same morning the nightly turned main red, both lanes found the same two causes and the repair is on main with the freeze on its way out.

notes.text: #3760 shipped: Z/X/C name LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT batteries on seat 2's wave — the arcade's three-button law reaches both seats; duty-swallowed latch, seat-worn HUD keys, join-card teach; 12 new sim/wiring pins, 53/53 mutants dead, a 16-check live Chrome drive.

Red main diagnosed and cleared: five demo pages were missing the 100dvh sibling (dvhcheck is nightly-only, so demos slip till morning) and the nightlybot roster regex had been blind to spec-carrying game entries since #3586. Fix landed as da3457a; both gates green at head.

Corpse handoff worked end to end: the previous slot-b session died mid-mutant-walk, but its pushed branch, checkpoint comments — and even the walk process itself — survived, so the resuming lane only had to watch for green and ship.
The never-dry board moved: PAC-MAN cleared once pacmandrive (#3781) landed; idle-kick now names DONKEY KONG — fire-floor rules and timer-zero capture are the next honest gaps.
